description: How long it takes to travel between two places, by road rather than as the crow flies. Can be asked about a future departure, or told when you need to arrive and answer when to leave

arrive_by.description: Be there by this time, as RFC3339. Answers when to leave. Cannot be combined with depart_at

depart_at.description: When the journey starts, as RFC3339 (e.g. 2026-08-13T08:00:00Z). Defaults to now. Traffic and timetables are read for this time

from.description: Where the journey starts, e.g. 'King's Cross, London' (or give from_lat/from_lon)

from_lat.description: Optional start latitude, if already known

from_lon.description: Optional start longitude, if already known

mode.description: How to travel: drive (default), walk, cycle or transit

to.description: Where the journey ends, e.g. 'Heathrow Airport'

to_lat.description: Optional end latitude, if already known

to_lon.description: Optional end longitude, if already known

name: routes_eta
title: Travel time
